blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Metro Manila and the rest of the country may experience isolated rain showers on Tuesday, Nov. 17, with the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) saying that the easterlies are still prevailing over the country. Pagasa, in its 5 p.m. weather forecast, said the Amihan, or northeast monsoon, is not affecting the country. However, it said scattered thunderstorms may still be experienced over parts of Caraga and Davao Regions.
